LESSON: WRITING 1.3.1 WRITING READINESS.

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Writing 1.3.1 Writing readiness.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 1.3.1 Writing readiness., part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we hold a pencil/pen when writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 1.3.1 Writing readiness. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: Learning independently as learner learns how to hold a writing tool properly.

● Creativity and Imagination: Experimenting with ideas as learner interacts with print materials and acquire new ideas

on how to hold writing tools in preparation for writing.

Values:
● Responsibility: Diligence as learner learns to hold a writing tool and write without assistance.

● Integrity: Accountability as learner shows commitment to write tasks given.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion: as learner works with others to make patterns.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Linked to all learning areas as the learner has to learn how to turn pages of books in all learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Adapted course book, Writing materials such as books, drawing books, pencils, pens, crayons, charts with drawn patterns
